notes: Chris Storm's IG46 roleplay, and the one that makes his storyline's debt explicit: four men in Italian suits jump him in his own locker room the night he wins the Infinite Gauntlet and give him a week to produce a quarter of a million dollars on a debt he says was settled four years ago; Tessa Windsor has already flown to Milwaukee with LeStatt Knight; a wrestling-news site runs the story as Storm preparing to throw his first defence, which brings a furious telephone call from Jericoholic Anonymous and a nervous one to Charlotte Ramone; and he ends up at a small apartment full of band merchandise, begging the former DWO World Champion Chryste — who walks with a cane because of what he did to her knee — for help. title: IG32 - Five

date.source: the forum's own post date

notes: Jay Phoenix’s Infinite Gauntlet 32 entry, structured in five chapters named for the stages of grief, plus a prologue and epilogue. Alone in a hotel room he booked so that no-one could find him, he refuses on the phone to honour a PRIME contract he says is not his — "your contract is meaningless. Ember wasn’t me!" — over the Unification Title match he has already no-showed and the Infinite Gauntlet 32 entry PRIME has scheduled him for, naming among his reasons a "fake ‘outing’ of me on your news site". He drinks the minibar dry and wrecks the room; the narration then lists what the word "episode" covers for him — two lost years, a state told either as multiple personality disorder or as possession by a never-born brother depending on who is asked, a career forced on him, and industry and forum gossip about his sexuality. In the fourth chapter he empties his prescribed medication onto the bed and picks up a pill; the text has already established an earlier attempt weeks before, which his childhood friend Rick James found him after and revived him from ("I don’t know why I bothered saving you … I should have just let you die!"). Rick reaches the room in time, scatters the pills and tells him not to fight it; Phoenix calls him "his love" and returns his kiss. The epilogue has an unseen photographer catch the two men in the doorway and report down a phone, "I got it all" — an exposure the roleplay leaves unresolved. Only this first post is the roleplay itself; posts 2-4 are brief OOC banter (a Chappelle’s Show "Rick James" pop-culture joke) and post 5 is Argyle’s admin note asking posters not to chatter after RP posts in-thread — none structured. No outcome is stated for the Infinite Gauntlet match. Rick James carries no confident registry match and is left unstructured as a character.

title: Unified Title Match: Sunken Utopia

date.source: the forum's own post date

notes: A first-person story of Tsuyoshi Tanaka, a heavy-drinking wrestler in a run-down East Brooklyn flat, who pictures himself beating Jason Snow for the PTC Unified Title. In a dream he crawls through a door into a peaceful alternate New York where his double is the mayor and married to the woman who left him in his own world. His arrival spreads violence through that world, a professor sends him back, and after a fight of wills with his double he wakes in his own bed.

title: Unified Title: "Born in the USA"

date.source: the forum's own post date

notes: Two narrators alternate. Samuel Henderson, whose father was shot in 2004 after running up gambling debts to a mob captain, hunts Jason Snow, the Canadian-born wrestler he believes is the mob's contract killer. Snow, raising his daughter with his late wife's two sisters, tells of ten killings and a growing numbness. On the Fourth of July Snow loses his temper with a sister-in-law and sits in his garage with a pistol in his mouth. Henderson follows him home with a revolver and cannot bring himself to fire.

sources.identifier: PTC forum, PTC's Infinite Gauntlet, post 237531

title: UT - I Love You to Death

date.source: the forum's own post date

notes: Written with a nod to Bram Stoker's Dracula, as therapy-session scenes interleaved with e-mails. Jason Snow's therapist treats his anger and the obsessive grief for his late wife. He begins dating a new kindergarten teacher, Alicia, who writes about him to her sister, while a restaurant-owner friend of his trades messages with him. Snow tells Alicia only that he is a PRIME wrestler and tells the therapist that every relationship he has will rest on a lie.

notes: A comic career retrospective of the Uber Judge, who says he failed at school and sport through drink, then tells the story of a mind-control plan and a rocket he built. Between sections he gives the account to a severed head of an actor and calls it the absolute truth. It closes on the line that he intended to challenge Jason Snow all along.

title: PTC Unified Triple Threat :: CLINTON SAGE :: "Curiosity"

date.source: the forum's own post date

notes: A story of Clinton Sage told in flashbacks around a hospital visit. A hospitalised man, Artur Marx, is visited by a hooded man, Nathan Hollinger, who wants Sage because he believes Sage killed his wife. The flashbacks show Sage using a psychologist's brain-washing program on his girlfriend Michele Thornton and strangling her cat. Hollinger learns the program, turns it on Sage with a trigger phrase, and Sage admits the killing.

title: UT - Cosa Nostra, Episode 9: "Please"

date.source: the forum's own post date

notes: Episode 9 of a serial told from several viewpoints. Jason Snow watches his mob friend Noah Sosiari die in a hospital while feeling nothing. His sister-in-law Danielle Manderly goes on a blind date, and his girlfriend Alicia Bryant ends their relationship after accusing him of loving Danielle. Snow learns of Noah's death by phone, finds Danielle with her date, kills the man and then Danielle, and the post ends as he opens his eyes at the voice of her sister Emily. A link to a hype video on PTC's community forum heads the post.

title: 2005: The Year of Almasy. - Seymour Almasy

date.source: the forum's own post date

notes: A post by Seymour Almasy saying 2004 was a good year for him, with the PTC Global Title won back at Survival and four UWF belts in three months, and that in 2005 he will start the year as Global Champion and will not lose it. He invites Jason Hughes, Tessa Windsor or Craig Goat to try.

title: 2005: The Year of Almasy. - Chris Storm

date.source: the forum's own post date

title: GTT3 Round Four roleplay - Angelo Deville

date.source: the roleplay's own author, introducing it on the forum: "the first roleplay I wrote for round four of GTT3 back in '02"

notes: Angelo Deville's first roleplay for the fourth round of GTT3, against Tessa Windsor. The tournament's board of directors questions him over the disappearance of Matt Blitz, his round-three opponent, and over rumours that he bought his late entry; he denies all of it, promises to be unethical with Tessa Windsor only in the ring, and walks out, leaving the board agreed that he strong-armed his way in. Reposted on the forum in January 2005, inside a free-agent application that also carries a roleplay of The Dread Pirate Roberts.

sources.identifier: PTC forum, Free Agents, post 132383

title: The Truth "They" Don't Want You To Know (2005 WOTY Nomination Hype)

date.source: the forum's own post date

notes: Five campaign pieces for PTC's 2005 Wrestler of the Year vote, made for Angelo Deville. Mock proofs set him against the other nominees: he pinned Karina Wolfenden cleanly at Colossus after she had pinned him amid the crowd of the Dual Halo; Los Diablos are mocked for their losses to him; Rich Rollins is said to be a computer effect; a point-by-point tally of Wolfenden's year against his comes out 9.5 to 7.5 in his favour; and Christian Zenith is said to have reached Seven of the Best only because Deville stood aside.
